planes: constitutional_brainstem: kernel.authority, kernel.evidence, platform.types and platform.wire define non-learnable authority, truth, privacy, deletion, fencing and evidence invariants
homeostatic_objective: objective.compiler and utility.ndu compile bounded goals, risk, resource, exploration and stop conditions without owning effects
executive_control: control.runtime selects signed global snapshots while intelligence.control composes one request against a frozen generation
cortical_execution: runtime.codex remains the sole model, session, turn and tool-execution spine; inference and prompt modules are bounded functional areas
basal_ganglia_gating: intuition.policy and checked authority gates select act, abstain, defer or enter a slower path
hippocampal_memory: cognitive, memory, knowledge and HNMF projections provide source-bound recall, replay and consolidation without becoming source truth
cerebellar_evaluation: learning.operator and learning.eval compute prediction error, calibration, retention, lesion, ablation and future-window evidence
autonomic_runtime: runtime.supervisor, runtime.fleet and runtime.agentd own health, backpressure, recovery, generation fencing and local last-known-good operation
immune_security: evidence, revocation, quarantine, deletion and unlearning prevent unauthorized activation and resurrection
peripheral_effectors: automation, Matrix, browser, UI, secret and external adapters perform typed effects only after final-payload-bound VerifiedUse
qualification: deterministic fixtures, fault injection, digital twins and independent decisions remain physically and logically outside production authority
engineering: learning.plasticity proposes parameter and topology candidates; control.engineering proposes source candidates and can never review, merge or promote itself
external_control: human and separately authorized selectors accept, promote, release, revoke and roll back signed generations
nonNegotiableInvariants: Codex App Server is the sole session, thread, turn, model-call and tool-execution spine.
Agentd is a thin lifecycle and composition host and owns no product-domain durable fact.
Every durable domain has one schema owner and one authoritative writer.
Cross-owner mutation uses local transaction, durable intent, outbox, destination dedupe/apply, acknowledgement and reconciliation.
Queue or dispatch acknowledgement is not terminal external-effect success.
Indeterminate remains open until current-fence reconciliation records applied, not applied or quarantined.
Every irreversible boundary consumes a final-payload-bound short-lived VerifiedUse token that the adapter cannot mint.
Hard objectives, authority, truth, privacy, deletion and writer ownership are not learnable.
Current-run objective, module, route, authority and learning-artifact snapshots are immutable.

Adaptive modules may diagnose and test their own next-generation artifacts or topology candidates, but cannot supply the independent evaluation or acceptance of their own candidates, self-authorize, self-accept, self-merge, self-promote or self-release.
Central optimizers select feasible plans but never execute physical effects, issue capabilities or bypass local reflex and last-known-good behavior.
Qualification fixtures and test signers never link into production artifacts.
The central nervous system is logically coordinated but physically distributed; no single process owns all facts, all authority or all execution.
Fast request control, medium artifact learning, slow structural plasticity and slowest source-code evolution use separate state, evidence and promotion gates.
Module addition, replacement, split, merge, retirement and rewiring are never in-place mutations; each creates a bounded next-generation topology candidate.

Every module candidate has a content-addressed manifest binding source commit, build provenance, capabilities, protocols, data ownership, authority class, resource bounds, qualification evidence and rollback predecessor.

Every active topology is an independently signed immutable snapshot with one predecessor, one generation fence, an exact module set, typed edges, selected artifacts, resource allocation and rollback identity.
Every authoritative-writer handoff has a state-handoff receipt proving old-writer fencing, migration digest, outbox drain, consumer cutover, new-writer readiness and rollback viability.
No topology may contain dependency cycles, two authoritative writers for one domain, an adapter that mints its own authority, an optimizer-to-effect edge or a qualification-to-production writer edge.
No module can widen its declared capabilities, resource envelope, network reach, secret reach, data class or effect class at runtime.
The no-change baseline is a mandatory candidate in every learned parameter, workflow, topology and source-code selection.
Candidate generation, execution, outcome observation, evaluation, selection and promotion use distinct identities and independently verifiable receipts.

Long-term learning requires complete candidate logging, propensity or deterministic policy identity, independent outcomes, support diagnostics, future-time holdouts, retention, rollback and deletion non-resurrection evidence.
Functional neural biomimicry claims require an implemented mechanism plus lesion or ablation evidence; biological or neuromorphic equivalence is outside current authority.
Embeddings, engrams, graph projections and model-generated trajectories are rebuildable projections and never replace source-ledger truth.
A deleted fact, module or artifact cannot reappear from cache, backup, replay, index, projection, checkpoint, canary or rollback without a new authorized source event.
Repository candidates are ordinary reviewable source; encoded carriers, workflow materializers, persisted checkout credentials, branch self-push and review-object substitution are forbidden.

Repository settings must require protected canonical branches, independent review, required exact-head and merge-candidate checks, no force push and designated ownership before self-iteration activation.
Degraded central control never blocks bounded local safety, stop, revoke, reconcile, drain or last-known-good operation.

route: kernel.authority validates immutable constitutional constraints and capability scope
objective.compiler compiles ObjectiveRevisionV1 into bounded hard constraints, soft dimensions, budgets and stop conditions
utility.ndu produces a deterministic or qualified preference-state utility view without issuing authority
control.runtime selects an already-qualified signed topology and control snapshot outside the local synchronous hot path
runtime.supervisor loads exactly one topology generation and enforces generation and writer fences
intelligence.control composes the request against the frozen objective, topology, prompt, memory and neuron artifact generation
context.compiler creates bounded provenance-bearing context from revalidated source and projection records
memory.retrieval, memory.federation, knowledge.graph and HNMF provide candidate recall with contradiction, staleness and deletion checks
neuron.runtime applies qualified sparse competition, inhibition, homeostasis, eligibility, modulation and abstention mechanisms
prompt.optimizer and intuition.policy choose a bounded intervention, action, abstention or slow path with complete candidate identity
runtime.agentd hosts lifecycle and composition but owns no durable product fact
runtime.codex performs the only model call and tool-execution session spine
kernel.operations and checked adapters consume final-payload-bound VerifiedUse and reconcile effects
learning.ledger records the complete decision episode and independently observed outcome
learning.operator and learning.eval produce causal, longitudinal, retention, lesion, ablation and rollback evidence
learning.plasticity may emit add, replace, split, merge, retire or rewire TopologyProposalV1 records with activationForbidden=true
control.engineering may emit ordinary-source pull-request candidates but has no review, merge, promotion or release capability
an independent selector may sign a future TopologySnapshot only after qualification; runtime.supervisor may canary or roll back that exact snapshot

theoryBoundaries.NDU: endogenous_preference_and_recursive_utility_semantics_guiding_multiscale_action_and_parameter_optimization; cells are scoped implementation units, not new subjects; explicit utility-to-gradient contract; deterministic baselines before qualified FBSDE candidates; no universal per-cell solver or efficacy theorem
theoryBoundaries.FBSDE: analysis_and_bounded_subject_models_not_universal_runtime_template; numerical solvers are candidate artifacts with convergence, conditioning, fallback and resource witnesses
theoryBoundaries.HolderBellman: registered_smooth_subspaces_only; nonsmooth, discontinuous, authority and effect boundaries use explicit guards rather than assumed differentiability
theoryBoundaries.assetPricing: prompt_control_asset_valuation_analogy_not_market_no_arbitrage_claim; shadow prices are optimization diagnostics, not financial facts or authority

fastSlowLoops.fast: reflex and request loops use one immutable signed generation, bounded local routing, abstention, fencing, last-known-good fallback and no online parameter, topology, schema, authority or source mutation
fastSlowLoops.slow: artifact, structural and source-evolution loops are separated: parameter candidates require causal future-window evidence; topology candidates require graph, resource, migration, shadow, canary and rollback witnesses; source candidates require ordinary reviewable code, independent CI, review and promotion

recoveryOrder: freeze new candidate promotion and preserve the current signed generation identity
